# mannerly

> A dependency-free fetch client with good manners, for Node 24+ (ESM, TypeScript). It spaces out requests, retries with exponential backoff, honours Retry-After, stops when blocked (403) and throws typed errors. Built for scrapers, feed builders and scheduled data pipelines.

Install: `npm install mannerly`. Everything is exported from `mannerly`: `HttpClient`, `crawlPages`, `nextCooldown`, `DEFAULT_SETTINGS`, the error classes and their option/response types.

## Quick start

```ts
import { HttpClient, BlockedError, NotFoundError, ScrapeError } from 'mannerly'; // or switch on error.kind, see Errors

// One client per site; reuse it so pacing and cookies are shared.
const http = new HttpClient({
  headers: { 'User-Agent': 'my-bot (+https://example.org/bot)' },
});

try {
  const page = await http.get('https://example.org/events', {
    marker: 'id="event-list"', // the page must contain this, else UnexpectedPageError
  });
  console.log(page.status, page.attempts, page.body.length);

  const { data } = await http.json('https://example.org/api/events?page=1'); // data: unknown
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof BlockedError) {
    // The site said stop. Do not retry now; back off for days (see nextCooldown).
  } else if (error instanceof NotFoundError) {
    // 404 or 410.
  } else if (error instanceof ScrapeError) {
    // Anything else mannerly throws, after retries ran out.
  } else {
    throw error;
  }
}
```

## API

- `new HttpClient(options?)`: `headers`, `settings`, `isMoved(requestedPath, finalPath)`, `deadlineAt`, `lastRequestAt`, `onRequest(at)`, `logger`, and injectable `fetch`, `sleep`, `now`, `random` (use them in tests).
- `http.get(url, { marker?, complete?, maxRetries? })` -> `{ url, finalUrl, status, body, bytes, durationMs, attempts }`. Reads text.
- `http.json(url, { method?, headers?, body?, maxRetries? })` -> `{ url, status, data, bytes, durationMs, attempts }`. `data` is `unknown`; `body` must already be a string.
- `http.requestCount`, `http.resetSession()`.
- `crawlPages(options)` walks `?page=1,2,3...` until the list ends; returns `{ complete, incompleteReason, pages, failure }`.
- `nextCooldown({ state: { blockStrikes }, now, days })` -> `{ blockedUntil, blockStrikes }`. Pure; you persist it.
- `DEFAULT_SETTINGS`: `minRequestIntervalMs` 2000, `requestJitterMs` 1000, `requestTimeoutMs` 30000, `maxRetries` 3, `backoffBaseMs` 2000, `maxRetryAfterMs` 120000, `maxRedirects` 5, `logBodyPreviewChars` 300.

## Errors

All extend `ScrapeError` (`status: number | null`, `body: string | null`, `name` = class name, and `kind`, a fixed string per class).

To branch on the failure, use `isKnownScrapeError(error)` and then `switch (error.kind)`; TypeScript narrows each case to its class. `kind` is `'blocked'`, `'deadline'`, `'empty-page'`, `'fetch'`, `'malformed-page'`, `'moved'`, `'not-found'` or `'unexpected-page'` (a plain `ScrapeError` is `'scrape'`).

```ts
if (isKnownScrapeError(error)) {
  switch (error.kind) {
    case 'blocked':
      return backOff(); // do not retry now
    case 'moved':
      return update(error.newPath);
    default:
      return skip();
  }
}
```

| Class                 | Thrown when                                                                                | Retried first? |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------- |
| `BlockedError`        | 403, or a `Retry-After` longer than `maxRetryAfterMs`                                      | no             |
| `NotFoundError`       | 404 or 410                                                                                 | no             |
| `MovedError`          | a redirect that `isMoved` accepts; `newPath` has the target                                | no             |
| `DeadlineError`       | the next wait would pass `deadlineAt`                                                      | no             |
| `FetchError`          | network error, timeout, 5xx/429 or other non-2xx, truncated page, body that is not JSON    | yes            |
| `UnexpectedPageError` | `marker` missing, or a redirect to another path that `isMoved` does not accept             | yes            |
| `EmptyPageError`      | empty body again after a fresh session (a first empty answer is retried as a warm-up)      | yes            |
| `MalformedPageError`  | not thrown by mannerly; you throw it from your `parse` callback in `crawlPages`            | n/a            |

"Retried first" means retried up to `maxRetries` times with backoff, then the last error is thrown.

## Rules of thumb

- `marker` is how you detect a login wall or maintenance page. Without it, any 2xx page is accepted. With it, the body must also end with `</html>` unless you pass `complete` (a RegExp, a predicate, or `false`; e.g. `/<\/feed>\s*$/` for Atom).
- Do not catch `BlockedError` and retry. Record it with `nextCooldown` and stop.
- Await each call before starting the next on a client. Calls started together can skip the spacing.
- Always send an identifying `User-Agent`. mannerly makes a client polite, it does not make a request welcome.
- In tests, pass fake `fetch`, `sleep: async () => {}`, `now` and `random`.
